segments.he: בָּרוּךְ־הַשֵּׁם, יוֹם א' וַיֵּרָא תקצ"ו לפ"ק נֶעמְרוֹב.
segments.en: To My beloved son — my dear one.
segments.he_nikud: בְּרוּךְהָשָׁם, יוֹם א' וַיַּרְא תקצ"ו לפ"ק נֶעמְרוֹב.

segments.en: I received your letter through the bearer of this letter on Friday — Erev Shabbas Kodesh. And behold — regarding the letter to the rabbi — the essential intention was that a person be found in your community who would speak with him in the spirit of my words in my letter — for my benefit. And since — according to his words — such a person is not to be found there — I therefore reconsidered and returned my feet to Your testimonies [Tehillim 119:59] — to rely on Hashem Yisborach alone — and to sit and not act — for it is not at all my wish that you yourself deliver the letter — and this never entered my mind at all. Even so — I am returning to you the copy in my son Rabbi Shachna's handwriting — may he live — that it should be with you — perhaps perhaps it will be needed for you — and perhaps even so a person will be found there who will direct his heart to Heaven to involve himself in this — to diminish the *machloket* — and may the Good Hashem do. More than this there is no leisure to extend — and the bearer of this letter — Rabbi Nachman of Tulchin — will tell you face to face everything. And praised be G-d — Hashem is with us and expands greatly for us within our distresses in His kindness — Yisborach — and a little of the sufferings and the expansions Rabbi Nachman of Tulchin — the bearer of this letter — will tell you.

segments.he: מִכְתָּבְךָ קִבַּלְתִּי עַל־יְדֵי מוֹסֵר כְּתָב זֶה בְּיוֹם ו', עֶרֶב שַׁבַּת־קֹדֶשׁ. וְהִנֵּה בְּעִנְיַן הָאִגֶּרֶת לְהָרַב, עִקַּר כַּוָּנָתִי הָיָה, שֶׁיִּמָּצֵא אִישׁ בִּקְהִלַּתְכֶם שֶׁיְּדַבֵּר עִמּוֹ מֵעֵין דְּבָרַי שֶׁבְּמִכְתָּבִי לְטוֹבָתִי; וּמֵאַחַר שֶׁלְּפִי דְּבָרָיו אֵין בַּנִּמְצָא שָׁם, עַל־כֵּן חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְּרָכַי וְאָשׁוּבָה רַגְלַי אֶל עֵדֹתֶיךָ לִסְמֹךְ עַל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ לְבַד וְלִהְיוֹת שֵׁב וְאַל תַּעֲשֶׂה, כִּי אֵין זֶה רְצוֹנִי כְּלָל, שֶׁאַתָּה בְּעַצְמְךָ תִּמְסֹר הָאִגֶּרֶת, וְזֶה לֹא עָלָה עַל דַּעְתִּי כְּלָל, אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן אֲנִי מַחֲזִיר לְךָ הַהַעְתָּקָה שֶׁל כְּתָב־יַד בְּנִי רַבִּי שַׁכְנָא שֶׁיִּחְיֶה, שֶׁיִּהְיוּ אֶצְלְךָ, אוּלַי אוּלַי יִהְיוּ נִצְרָךְ לְךָ וְאוּלַי אַף־עַל־פִּי־כֵן יִהְיֶה נִמְצָא שָׁם אִישׁ שֶׁיְּכַוֵּן לְבּוֹ לַשָּׁמַיִם לְהַכְנִיס אֶת עַצְמוֹ בָּזֶה לְמַעֵט הַמַחֲלֹקֶת וְה' הַטּוֹב יַעֲשֶׂה. יֶתֶר מִזֶּה אֵין פְּנַאי לְהַאֲרִיךְ, וּמוֹסֵר כְּתָב זֶה יְסַפֵּר לְךָ פָּנִים אֶל פָּנִים הַכֹּל. וּתְהִלָּה לָאֵל, ה' אִתָּנוּ וּמַרְחִיב לָנוּ הַרְבֵּה בְּצָרוֹתֵינוּ בְּחַסְדּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, וּמְעַט יְסַפֵּר לְךָ מוֹסֵר כְּתָב זֶה רַבִּי נַחְמָן מִטּוּלְטְשִׁין, מֵהַיִּסּוּרִים וְהַרְחָבוֹת. וּבַה' בָּטַחְתִּי, שֶׁמִּדָּה טוֹבָה מְרֻבָּה וּבְוַדַּאי הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה גְּדוֹלָה וְאָנוּ צְרִיכִין לְהִתְחַזֵּק וּלְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם לֵילֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים לְהַחֲיוֹת עַצְמֵנוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹת חֲסָדָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזָּכִינוּ לְהִמָּלֵט מִלִּהְיוֹת מֵהַחוֹלְקִים עַל נְקֻדַּת הָאֱמֶת וְכוּ', וּבָזֶה לְבַד אָנוּ יְכוֹלִים לִחְיוֹת וְלִשְׂמֹחַ גַּם עַתָּה עַד אֲשֶׁר יַרְחִיב ה' לָנוּ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, וְנִזְכֶּה לָצֵאת מִכָּל צָרוֹתֵינוּ לְגַמְרֵי וְיִתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לְטוֹבָה גְּדוֹלָה, לְשָׂשׂוֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָה מְהֵרָה.
segments.en: And I trusted in Hashem — for the attribute of good is abundant [Sotah 11a] — and certainly everything is for great good. And we need to strengthen ourselves and renew ourselves every day — to walk in His holy ways — to give ourselves life through the wonders of His kindnesses — Yisborach — that we merited to escape from being among those who oppose the point of truth — and in this alone we can live and rejoice even now — until Hashem expands for us in fullness — and we merit to come out from all our distresses entirely — and everything will turn to great good — to joy and to gladness — quickly .

segments.en: The words of your father who intercedes for you all.

Nussun of Breslov. Overview: Sunday, Parshas Vayeira — Nemirov. Received Yitzchok's letter on Friday. Regarding the letter to the rabbi of Savran: the intention was that someone in the community speak with him in the spirit of Reb Nussun's letter — but no such person is to be found there. Therefore *chishamti d'rachai va'ashuva raglai el eidosecha* — returned feet to Hashem's testimonies — to rely on Hashem alone and sit and not act. He never intended Yitzchok himself to deliver the letter. Returning the copy in Rabbi Shachna's handwriting — perhaps perhaps it will be needed — perhaps a person will be found who will direct his heart to Heaven. Rabbi Nachman of Tulchin will tell of the sufferings and expansions. *U'vaHashem batachti — midah tovah merubah* — certainly all is for great good — strengthen and renew ourselves every day to walk in His holy ways — that we merited to escape from being among those who oppose the point of truth — in this alone we can live and rejoice even now — until Hashem expands for us fully — and everything turns to great good — *l'sason u'l'simchah m'heirah.*
